scope.zh: 下层及车库地坪、门口平台、条形基础、左侧挡土墙与回墙、10处柱基/扩大基础、空调垫板；包括普通土方、钢筋模板、泵送、人工、基层、排水防水和清理。
scope.en: Lower-level/garage slab, landing, strip footings, retaining wall/returns, 10 pads, HVAC pad; ordinary earthwork, reinforcing/formwork, pumping, labor, base, drainage/waterproofing and cleanup.

source.zh: 18页住宅图纸的去标识算例，重点为第4-8、12-13页。所有未核墙高及节点假设保留说明，未附客户图纸。
source.en: De-identified 18-sheet residential example, mainly pages 4-8 and 12-13. Unverified wall heights/details remain labeled assumptions; customer drawings are not included.

tax_note.zh: 未另计销售税/使用税；当地税费及报价包含方式待核实。
tax_note.en: Sales/use tax has not been added. Confirm local taxes and what supplier quotes include.

price_note.zh: 去标识历史示例，费率为当时的预算假设，未取得当地供应商或承包商报价；不是当前价格或固定报价。
price_note.en: De-identified historical example. Rates are unquoted estimating allowances from the original estimate, not current prices or fixed bids.

source.zh: 第8页设备垫板示意，尺寸待核

quantities.formula: strip_width_ft * (strip20_length_ft * (20 - slab_in) / 12 + strip24_length_ft * (24 - slab_in) / 12 + strip36_length_ft * (36 - slab_in) / 12) / 27

basis.zh: 总长178.5英尺，按20/24/36英寸分组；扣4英寸地坪。
basis.en: 178.5 ft grouped at 20/24/36 in heights; deduct 4 in slab.

basis.zh: 主墙暂按9英尺高；底座暂按24英寸宽×12英寸厚。
basis.en: Assume 9 ft wall; footing 24 in wide x 12 in thick.

source.zh: 第8、13页；9英尺为适用最大值，非实测
source.en: Pages 8/13; 9 ft is a maximum detail height, not measured

quantities.formula: return_length_ft * (wall_thickness_in / 12 * return_avg_height_ft + return_footing_width_ft * return_footing_depth_ft + key_width_ft * key_depth_ft) / 27

basis.zh: 总长12英尺，平均墙高4.5英尺；底座及键保守暂列。
basis.en: 12 ft total, 4.5 ft average wall height; provisional footing/key.

source.zh: 第13页详图29，高档表值用于预算
source.en: Page 13 Detail 29; upper schedule values used for allowance

basis.en: 2 PAD36, 2 PAD30, 4 PAD24, 2 PAD18; deduct strip overlaps.

source.zh: 第8页；毛量1.89立方码，净增加暂按1
source.en: Page 8; gross 1.89 yd3, net allowance 1 yd3

price_basis.zh: 低/中/高190/210/240美元每立方码，暂含常规运输；基准订货覆盖为40立方码，保留原预算保守取整。
price_basis.en: Low/base/high USD 190/210/240 per yd3, provisionally including standard delivery. Base order override of 40 yd3 preserves the original conservative allowance.

basis.zh: 综合人工包含工资及雇主用工负担。机械土方和泵车已含各自操作员，不在此重复；管理利润另计。每工日按8小时，检查和养护会增加日历工期。
basis.en: Labor includes wages and employer burden. Excavation and pump subcontract allowances include their operators; do not count them again here. Overall overhead/profit is separate. Worker-days use 8 hours; inspections and curing extend calendar duration.

basis.zh: 钢筋约0.8-1.2公吨及锚件，待翻样。
basis.en: Approx. 0.8-1.2 metric tonnes plus embeds; verify bar schedule.

basis.zh: 高挡土墙及条基模板，人工另计。
basis.en: Retaining-wall and footing forms; labor separate.

basis.zh: 询价暂按碎石12立方码、砂6立方码及隔汽膜；排水碎石另留。
basis.en: Provisional 12 yd3 aggregate, 6 yd3 sand and vapor barrier; additional drainage aggregate.

basis.zh: 穿孔管、滤布、防水保护材料。
basis.en: Perforated pipe, filter fabric and waterproof/protection materials.

basis.zh: 机械分包含司机及普通弃土；土方未测量。
basis.en: Equipment subcontract includes operators/ordinary disposal; earthwork unmeasured.

basis.zh: 普通材料小设备及清理。
basis.en: Ordinary consumables, small equipment and cleanup.

assumptions.zh: 主墙9英尺为预算假设，不是图纸明确实际高。每增加1英尺高，单墙身约增加0.69立方码。
assumptions.en: The 9 ft main wall is assumed, not a confirmed actual height. Each extra foot adds about 0.69 yd3 of wall concrete.

assumptions.zh: 回墙平均高4.5英尺，底座宽5英尺4英寸、厚12英寸，键宽12英寸深30英寸均用于预算，不是结构设计。
assumptions.en: Returns assume 4.5 ft average height, 5 ft 4 in x 12 in footings and 12 in x 30 in keys; these are takeoff allowances, not design.

assumptions.zh: 普通条基长度分组和交叠需核；柱基毛量1.89立方码，扣重后净增加暂按1。
assumptions.en: Verify strip height groups and overlaps. Pad gross volume is 1.89 yd3; provisional net addition is 1 yd3.

assumptions.zh: 地坪一般说明#3@24英寸，挡土墙节点附近另见#4@24英寸；建筑立面另有砌块墙文字，需与现浇详图协调。
assumptions.en: General slab notes show #3 at 24 in; retaining details show #4 at 24 in. Reconcile architectural block-wall notes with cast-in-place details.

verification.zh: 核实墙高、回墙高程、各详图适用位置及最终混凝土强度配筋。
verification.en: Confirm wall heights, return elevations, detail mapping, final concrete strength and reinforcement.

verification.zh: 核实承载土层、挖土运距、机械及泵车通道、排水出口和分次浇筑量。
verification.en: Confirm bearing soil, haul distance, equipment/pump access, drainage outlets and pour quantities.

exclusions.zh: 上部木楼板木露台、木楼梯、整条车道、未明确露台及图外挡土墙、地下管线、设计许可和特殊检测另计。
exclusions.en: Upper timber floors/decks/stairs, full driveway, undefined patios/off-plan walls, underground services, design/permits and special inspections excluded.

exclusions.zh: 桩基、岩石、特殊降水支护及污染土处理不在普通土方暂列范围。
exclusions.en: Piles, rock, special dewatering/shoring and contaminated soil are outside ordinary earthwork allowances.
